export PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin; id; printf "[tools root]

export PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin; printf "[systemd tool search]

" "$?"; printf "[systemd version]

" "$?"

"; ls -ld /opt/usr/lko_task6; printf "TEMP-LS-EXIT=%s
